description: This file defines the Settings user control for a calculator app, including UI initialization, theme selection, accessibility announcements, and navigation handling.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A user control for managing application settings, including theme, version info, and accessibility features.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Constructor initializing the settings control, loading resources, and setting up UI elements.

methods.name: OnThemeSelectionChanged
methods.description: Handles theme change events triggered by user selection.

methods.name: SetDefaultFocus
methods.description: Sets focus to the theme expander control.

methods.name: OnLoaded
methods.description: Event handler for control load, sets up navigation and accessibility announcements.

methods.name: AnnouncePageOpened
methods.description: Announces that the settings page has been opened for accessibility.

methods.name: OnUnloaded
methods.description: Event handler for control unload, cleans up event subscriptions.

methods.name: FeedbackButton_Click
methods.description: Opens feedback URI with app version info.

methods.name: SetVersionString
methods.description: Sets the version string in the about section.

methods.name: InitializeContributeTextBlock
methods.description: Prepares the contribute hyperlink text with proper formatting.

methods.name: System_BackRequested
methods.description: Handles back navigation requests, invoking the back button automation pattern.

methods.name: BackButton_Click
methods.description: Raises the BackButtonClick event when the back button is clicked.
